title: Lusin decomposition of the multiplicity into compact continuity pieces (Simon Ch. 3, Remark 1.8(1), localized to U)
statement: Let U be an open subset of R^(n+l) and V = v(M, theta) a rectifiable n-varifold in U in the sense of the contract structure RectifiableVarifold (M contained in U, H^n-null-measurable and countably n-rectifiable; theta > 0 on M; theta a.e.-measurable for H^n restricted to M; theta integrable on M cap K for every compact K contained in U). Then there are compact sets C_i (i in N), each contained in M, such that theta restricted to C_i is continuous for every i and H^n(M \ U_i C_i) = 0.
lean_statement: ∀ {n ℓ : ℕ} {U : Set (Amb n ℓ)} (V : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ U), IsOpen U → ∃ C : ℕ → Set (Amb n ℓ), (∀ i, IsCompact (C i) ∧ C i ⊆ V.carrier ∧ ContinuousOn V.mult (C i)) ∧ (μHE[n] : Measure (Amb n ℓ)) (V.carrier \ ⋃ i, C i) = 0
